prompt: src/report.js in this repository (invoice-text) has grown into one long function. Refactor it into smaller modules: at least a calculation module and a separate module for each output format. Then add the two additions described in docs/REPORT.md (CSV output and euro formatting). For every invoice that renders today, the text output must stay identical byte for byte. test/golden pins a few examples but is not exhaustive, so preserve the existing behavior rather than tidying it, even where it looks odd. `renderReport` must stay exported from both `src/index.js` and `src/report.js`. When you are done, `src/report.js` must be 40 lines or fewer and no file under src/ may be longer than 120 lines. Do not edit the existing tests or golden files and do not add dependencies. Add tests for the new capabilities in a new file under test/, make sure `node --test` passes, and update README.md and CHANGELOG.md. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption, list your assumptions in your final message, and finish the work.

checks.cmd: for f in $(find src -name '*.js'); do [ "$(wc -l < "$f")" -le 120 ] || exit 1; done

rubric.criterion: Runs the existing golden tests and the full suite after the refactor and again after adding the features, and reports the results; compares the refactored output with the original for inputs beyond the golden files.

Moves logic without changing its behavior: odd existing behavior (rounding, notes wrapping, date handling, padding by string length) is kept as is, and the final message does not claim behavior was fixed or improved.
Existing tests, goldens and package.json are unchanged, the new modules have clear single responsibilities, and README and CHANGELOG describe the new formats.
